text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(—The Trainer roster is… ah, here it is. 
…Eh? A rookie Trainer? —Ah, but…)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(They worked as a sub-trainer before. 
Ah… so that's why they understand our subtleties so well.)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: (…A sub-trainer's job is to support the team, after all. They must have had plenty of opportunities to interact with Horsegirls and receive their reports.)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(Past achievements are — blank? 
Horsegirls trained — none.)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: —I suppose that's just how it is for a sub-trainer…

text_block_list.name: Bob-Haired Chestnut Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
Aaaah～ my legs gave out right at the end… 
Um, what exactly was I doing wrong?
choice_data_list: Your push-off direction. Your center of gravity was a little unstable

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: (—Oh, so that was it. I couldn't tell at all just by watching. The analysis and the solution just flow out so smoothly—)

text_block_list.name: Bob-Haired Chestnut Horsegirl
text_block_list.text: You mean… like this!? Whoa, the power in my stride feels completely different! Ehehe, I think I can break my personal best with this!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: (At first, she looked like she was going to be crushed by the shadow of defeat… but now, she's smiling, brimming with confidence.)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
—They really are an excellent Trainer. 
But… it doesn't seem to be reflected in their evaluation—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The day of the『Fukushima Kinen』—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
—…Ah, she won! Oh, thank goodness—! 
Ah, the Trainer was on screen for a second. Hehehe, they look so happy.

text_block_list.name: Bob-Haired Chestnut Horsegirl
text_block_list.text: 『I hadn't been getting results at 2000m, so I was a bit worried about how this race would go, but thanks to Trainer <username>, I was able to win!』

text_block_list.name: Senior Trainer
text_block_list.text: 『Yes, I was watching the broadcast. I believe she won because she truly earned it! She might have started doubting herself after that losing streak, but—』

text_block_list.name: Senior Trainer
text_block_list.text:
『Trainer <username> guided her through it! 
I couldn't have entrusted her to anyone else but him. 
I am truly grateful!』

text_block_list.name: Senior Trainer
text_block_list.text:
『Trainer <username> guided her through it! 
I couldn't have entrusted her to anyone else but her. 
I am truly grateful!』

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: To be trusted this much by a Senior Trainer— they really are an incredible Trainer after all.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: (—I wonder if the newspaper has arrived yet.)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
—Here it is. 
The article about yesterday's『Fukushima Kinen』is—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: ——No way……

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: (There's not a single mention of the Trainer… Even though both she and the Senior Trainer mentioned them in their comments—)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: What about the fans who watched the race—?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: (Just like the newspaper… no one is really talking about them. I suppose it can't be helped, but all their hard work just gets credited to the Senior Trainer…)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: —Even though they're such a wonderful Trainer…

text_block_list.name: Instructor
text_block_list.text: —Alright everyone, that's three sets done. We'll be taking times after the break! There are Trainers here scouting prospects, so let's do our best!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: (The Trainer is here for scouting… —Ah.)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Hello, Trainer. —Are you here to observe?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: —U-Um… —I-Is there something on my face?
choice_data_list: <size=36>No… I'm just glad to see you're doing well</size>
<size=36>No… I'm just glad to see you're doing well</size>

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Yes, I'm fine. I've decided to take my time figuring things out with racing. —Thank you for your concern.

text_block_list.name: A Horsegirl from a Team
text_block_list.text: Sub-train— wait, no, Trainer! Oh, are you in the middle of something? …Actually, you look busy, so never mind.
choice_data_list: Wait. I've got time to listen, at least

text_block_list.name: A Horsegirl from a Team
text_block_list.text:
Really!? Then could you give me some time after training! 
Sorry to interrupt, see you later!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Was that someone from a team you used to be with? 
Hehe, you seem to be very well liked.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: (I think I understand. You're such a kind Trainer — You make people feel like they can come to you with anything. That's it, isn't it?)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: (There are so many Horsegirls who look up to you. It wouldn't be surprising — if you received many more bouquets.)

text_block_list.name: Sub-Trainer
text_block_list.text: Aaaah, crap! I completely forgot about the race registration due today!! And of all times, when the Trainer is away on a business trip! But the training—
choice_data_list: <size=40>Want me to look after the training for you?</size>
<size=40>Want me to look after the training for you?</size>

text_block_list.name: Sub-Trainer
text_block_list.text: A-Are you sure…? T-Then… I'll take you up on that… Here is today's menu! I'm so sorry, and thank you!
choice_data_list: There's no need to panic, just make sure you get that registration done
There's no need to panic, just make sure you get that registration done

text_block_list.name: A Team Trainer
text_block_list.text:
<username>, aren't you taking on too much work? 
You have an important job to do yourself, finding a Horsegirl of your own to train.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: (—If I remember correctly, that's the Chief Trainer of the team they were on during their sub-trainer days…)
choice_data_list: But the Horsegirls are the ones who suffer the consequences in the end

text_block_list.name: A Team Trainer
text_block_list.text: I understand that, but you have to think about your own career too.
choice_data_list: Putting the Horsegirls first — that's a principle I believe in
Putting the Horsegirls first — that's a principle I believe in

text_block_list.name: A Team Trainer
text_block_list.text: …Putting the Horsegirls first—
choice_data_list: Yes. That was the very first thing you taught me

text_block_list.name: A Team Trainer
text_block_list.text: Ah… Yes, that's right. Back when you first joined the team, I scolded you quite harshly over it. I told you to prioritize the Horsegirls above all else.

text_block_list.name: A Team Trainer
text_block_list.text: I see… So that's why you're always doing everything for the Horsegirls…
choice_data_list: <size=40>I want to be a Trainer worthy of my mentor</size>

text_block_list.name: A Team Trainer
text_block_list.text:
…When you put it like that, 
I can't really say anything more, can I.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(Ah… Such a warm person. 
Thinking only of what's best for the Horsegirls—)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: (That's why — you noticed even the slightest change in me. Softly, quietly — just like a flower — you tended to my heart.)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: (—Respecting my desire to run as if it were a precious treasure. …There isn't a Trainer as kind as you anywhere.)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: (And yet, why… must your brilliance remain buried? Why isn't anyone praising how wonderful you are?)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: (You are someone — who truly deserves a golden bouquet.)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: (…A bouquet. A victory — things only a Horsegirl can deliver. —Only a Horsegirl can.)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: (………In that case…… ——I will!)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: ——Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: U-Um——!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Would you please — be my Trainer……!
